sources.title: AXERA-TECH/bevformer · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository contains the BEVFormer model converted for high-performance inference on the Axera NPU. BEVFormer is a paradigm-shifting transformer-based framework for 3D object detection that learns unified spatio-temporal bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations from multi-camera inputs.

sources.title: A Deep Dive into BEVFormer | Alex's Blog
sources.snippet: Dataset & Dependencies nuScenes BEVFormer is developed and evaluated on the nuScenes dataset, a large-scale benchmark for autonomous driving. nuScenes provides synchronized data from multiple cameras, LiDAR, radar, and rich metadata, making it well-suited for BEV-based perception research.
